convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'XMA_Ichimoku_Channel' custom indicator with 10 parameters, plus two external .mqh includes (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh). The custom indicator provides channel upper/lower bands that must be manually reimplemented in Python.

derived_values.name: UpValue - Channel upper border from buffer 1
DnValue - Channel lower border from buffer 2
XMA smoothed average (implied buffer 0)
derived_values.formula: SmoothAlgorithms CXMA applied to price with XMA_Method over XLength with XPhase, then channel bands at +/- Up_percent/Dn_percent deviation

other_exits: Long position closed when Close[1] < DnValue[1] (short signal triggers BUY_Close=true)
Short position closed when Close[1] > UpValue[1] (long signal triggers SELL_Close=true)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM input: negative values treated as fixed lot size, positive as deposit share fraction

custom_logic_notes: Channel breakout system: price closing above upper channel band triggers long entry; price closing below lower channel band triggers short entry. Opposite signal closes existing position. The crossover check uses bar[1] close vs band[1] with confirmation that previous bar[0] was on the other side of the band, ensuring a true crossover rather than sustained position. SignalBar=1 means signals evaluated on the previous completed bar. The XMA_Ichimoku_Channel custom indicator smooths highs/lows with configurable averaging method (SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA) then applies percentage deviation for channel bands. GlobalVariableDel_ on deinit suggests persistent state cleanup. Recount flag handles buffer copy failures with retry on next tick.
external_dependencies: SmoothAlgorithms.mqh - Averaging algorithm library (CXMA class, GetStartBars method)
TradeAlgorithms.mqh - Trade execution functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_)
XMA_Ichimoku_Channel.ex5 - Custom indicator providing channel bands via buffers 1 (upper) and 2 (lower)
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement the XMA_Ichimoku_Channel indicator in Python: (1) compute rolling max of highs over Up_period and rolling min of lows over Dn_period, (2) apply XMA smoothing (default SMA period=100) to both series, (3) apply percentage deviation (Up_percent/Dn_percent) to create upper/lower channel bands. The SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library supports 10 smoothing methods - at minimum SMA must be implemented. Entry signal: close crosses above upper band -> long; close crosses below lower band -> short. Exit: fixed SL=1000pts, TP=2000pts plus signal reversal close. Position sizing: MM=-0.1 means fixed 0.1 lot (negative = lot size). New-bar guard restricts signal evaluation to bar completion. TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions must be replaced with standard market order simulation. The crossover confirmation (bar[0] on opposite side vs bar[1] on breakout side) is critical to replicate accurately.
